description:
CONTINUITY DEFAULTS ("behave like the source") on a database migrated by EITHER path, in the
    background. path='upgraded' (official service / OpenUpgrade, ids preserved): by default only the
    steps that re-apply source BEHAVIOUR an in-place upgrade does not carry - menu groups of the source
    (noupdate), Settings implied groups, user groups at least as in the source, rights 20 split into
    new groups, saved filters, foreign-country work entry types, employee time zones, report
    backgrounds, language URL codes. Structural steps (account groups -> parent accounts, contract ->
    employee types, flexible / work-centre calendars, currency rate dates) may already have been done
    by the upgrade's own scripts: they run only when named in `steps`, after checking. path='pump':
    any step (the pump already runs them all after its copy; re-run after a module update).
    `options` = the same client decisions as data_pump_run (e.g. menu_groups, currency_shift,
    param_keep) - pass the SAME options as the build, else a re-run applies the generic defaults.
name: data_pump_continuity
